scope: SVF only; no UMEP ground-view interpretation.
question: Whether the open-scene directional SVF unity expectation is valid for the executed discrete angular integration.

test.finding: VEGETATION_OPEN_FIELDS includes total vegetation fields and eight directional vegetation/adjusted fields, then requires every one to equal 1.0.

candidate.finding: Each consumer patch contributes annulus_weight times its visibility mask; directional fields receive the anisotropic weight only when the consumer azimuth falls in the corresponding cardinal sector. The initializer and consumer use different loop bounds.

pinned_upstream.finding: The pinned implementation uses the same discrete annulus weights and cardinal-sector predicates (E 0<=azimuth<180, S 90<=azimuth<270, W 180<=azimuth<360, N azimuth>=270 or <90), with initializer bound int(360 / skyvaultaziint[j]) and consumer bound aziinterval[i].

pinned_upstream_float32_emulation.qualification: Source-derived float32 emulation, not a candidate execution or golden artifact.

initializer_consumer_trace.interpretation: Actual isolated original Torch CPU and candidate executions both write 149 entries with identical per-band counts and four zero slots before the consumer reads all 153 declared patches. The earlier source-only upstream float32 emulation predicted 150 and is retained only as a disproved approximation.

actual_isolated_execution.finding: Actual isolated execution supersedes the source-only direct-division emulation: original Torch CPU and candidate both write the same 149-entry stream and leave four trailing zeros.

emulated_directional_sums.method: Standard-library float32 rounding emulation using the candidate source formulas, open masks equal to one, candidate initializer/consumer bounds, and no model import or execution.
emulated_directional_sums.qualification: Diagnostic approximation only; it is not a replacement for an executed oracle and does not authorize a source or test change.

finding.claim: Unity is physically plausible for an unobstructed open sky and is established for the original per-patch visibility channels and isotropic vegetation fields, but the current directional outputs cannot be interpreted from sector quadrature alone until the initializer/consumer count mismatch is resolved.
finding.reason: Executed evidence establishes inherited compatibility behavior: option 2 declares 153 patches, while both original Torch CPU and candidate initializers write the same 149 azimuths and leave four trailing zero slots. Cross-band reads and zero azimuths alter cardinal-sector membership and explain why sector quadrature alone cannot justify unity.
finding.compatibility: The 149-entry initializer stream is inherited actual upstream CPU compatibility behavior and the candidate matches it. Keep that compatibility evidence separate from the failed scientific unity expectation; any corrected 153-entry stream requires an explicit scientific-deviation policy and new evidence.
finding.scientific_disposition: Preserve the two failed unity checks pending an explicit decision. Do not remove them merely because the candidate/reference outputs agree. The next bounded review should characterize a corrected one-entry-per-declared-patch stream and compare it against an independently defined continuous or normalized-sector expectation; any source change requires a separate compatibility policy and regenerated evidence.

limitations: The queued XML contains other Cura environment/scientific findings; only the two SVF open cases are assessed here.
This diagnoses compatibility and the authored expectation; it does not establish continuous-hemisphere physical accuracy.
The review itself did not rerun full SVF; a later isolated initializer-only execution characterized arithmetic without shadows or SVF evaluation.

executed_followup.result: Actual original Torch CPU and candidate both declare 153 and initialize 149 entries; full arrays and per-band counts are identical.
executed_followup.supersedes: Earlier direct-division float32 emulation predicting 150 upstream entries is disproved by actual Torch execution.
executed_followup.disposition: Inherited initializer truncation and band shifts remain compatibility behavior. Independent unity failures remain failed; no gate or model change authorized by this diagnosis.
